input.prompt: Compose an original48.6-second instrumental chill-hop / clean lo-fi electronic pop cue at96 BPM. Warm Rhodes-style electric piano chords and a soft analog pad, smooth rounded synth bass, relaxed but precise kick, crisp layered clap/snap snare, delicate closed-hi-hat shaker patterns. A gentle short-decay plinky synth motif enters intermittently; spacious, optimistic and sophisticated, small natural swing, no vinyl noise. Start with keys and beat, introduce a few tasteful layers through the middle, stay relaxed and understated. Near43 seconds let the drums and bass fade away into a simple ambient warm pad and two or three soft original closing notes, ending naturally by48.6 seconds. No vocals, no speech, no sampled music, no interface sounds. New harmony and melody.
